statement: Astrophysics is a branch of astronomy concerned with the physics and physical properties of celestial objects.

support.quote:
Astrophysics is the branch of astronomy that
deals with the physics and physical properties of these celestial
objects, such as their luminosity, age, and composition.

statement: NASA explicitly identifies the transit method as one of the methods astronomers use to study exoplanets, supporting its classification as an astronomical method.

scope.assumptions: An exoplanet passes in front of its host star as viewed by the observer.
scope.quantifiers: One of the methods astronomers use

support.quote: One of the methods astronomers use to study exoplanets is called the transit method, because as seen from our vantage point, the exoplanet passes in front of, or transits, the star.
